venues.name: Taphouse
venues.description: Located in the historic Burdette Building, this taproom offers a curated selection of 30 rotating craft beer taps and 22 wines. The space features a pet-friendly patio and hosts live music on weekends.

venues.name: Rocco's
venues.description: Rocco's Tacos & Tequila Bar provides an energetic environment focused on authentic Mexican cuisine and handcrafted margaritas. The venue is known for its tableside guacamole and a lively atmosphere that captures the spirit of a traditional fiesta.

venues.name: Lewis Barbecue
venues.description: This Greenville destination brings authentic Central Texas-style barbecue to the Upstate, featuring legendary brisket and house-made sausages. Guests can enjoy their meal in a laid-back atmosphere with a spacious backyard patio and honky-tonk music.

venues.name: Bakers Bar
venues.description: Located in the South Windermere neighborhood, this spot specializes in artisanal dough and pizza. It offers a casual atmosphere perfect for gathering with friends or family.

venues.name: Up on the Roof
venues.description: Perched above downtown with sweeping views of the Reedy River and Blue Ridge Mountains, this spot offers a chef-driven, seasonally inspired menu paired with handcrafted cocktails. The space features both an al fresco terrace and an interior with floor-to-ceiling windows, providing a versatile setting for celebrations or casual evenings.

venues.name: Bubba Annie's
venues.description: A locally owned restaurant established in 1999, Bubba Annie's serves a daily changing meat-and-three lineup alongside a full menu of burgers, wings, and sandwiches. The space offers a family-friendly environment for watching sporting events.

venues.name: Woodside Bistro
venues.description: Located at The Lofts at Woodside Mill, this neighborhood spot offers a relaxed setting for enjoying creative dishes and a full bar. It is a go-to destination for those seeking a consistent menu of comfort food and classic drinks in a welcoming environment.

venues.name: Firebirds Wood Fired Grill
venues.description: Firebirds Wood Fired Grill offers a contemporary dining experience centered around an open-flame, wood-fired kitchen. Guests can enjoy hand-cut steaks, fresh seafood, and signature drinks within an inviting atmosphere featuring a dedicated bar and lounge area.

venues.name: Cantina 76
venues.description: Cantina 76 is a vibrant Mexican-inspired restaurant and bar, known for its fresh, creative tacos, hand-crafted margaritas, and upbeat atmosphere. This lively establishment features a sidewalk patio on ONE City Plaza and welcomes both families and dogs.

Wed: Margarita Wednesdays: $2 off select premium tequilas
Fri: Corona Fridays: $2.50 off Corona + Corona Light

venues.name: The Trappe Door
venues.description: Located in the heart of downtown, this hidden gem offers a warm, rustic ambiance and a hearty Belgian-inspired menu. Guests can enjoy an extensive selection of Belgian beers alongside signature cocktails and authentic cuisine.

venues.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Greenville Woodruff Road
venues.description: Located within the DoubleTree by Hilton, the Woodside Grill offers an upscale contemporary setting for American dining. Guests can enjoy locally brewed draft beers, wine, and hand-crafted cocktails in the lounge area.

venues.name: Vault and Vator
venues.description: Vault & Vator is a speakeasy-style cocktail bar known for its unique, intimate atmosphere and expertly crafted drinks. The bar is deliberately hard to find, offering a sophisticated and quiet drinking experience.

venues.name: Aloft Greenville Downtown
venues.description: This downtown lounge serves as a social hub featuring live music and signature cocktails. Guests can enjoy bar bites and beverages in a modern, open-concept space with rooftop views.

venues.name: Ciclops Cyderi & Brewery
venues.description: Located on the rail trail, this Spartanburg brewery and cidery crafts house-made beer and cider in a space that embraces the weird. The venue features a food menu, arcade games, and regular events like trivia and themed game shows.

venues.name: New South Spirits Distillery
venues.description: Located in the heart of Greenville, this distillery specializes in small-batch spirits crafted with local ingredients. Guests can enjoy a refined tasting experience in an intimate setting that highlights the art of regional distillation.

venues.name: Embassy Suites Golf Resort & Conference Center
venues.description: Situated on over 100 acres in the Verdae development, this resort features an on-site lounge and championship golf course. Guests enjoy a daily evening reception providing complimentary snacks and drinks.
deals: Complimentary snacks and drinks during evening reception

venues.name: UnderPin Lanes 'N Lounge
venues.description: UnderPin Lanes 'N Lounge is a boutique bowling alley located in a historic warehouse space in downtown Spartanburg. It features eight full-service lanes alongside a dedicated bar and dining area serving casual fare, beer, and premium cocktails.

venues.name: Matador
venues.description: Located in the historic West End, this spot offers a deep selection of agave spirits and scratch-made Mexican cuisine. The space features warm, handcrafted details and a vibrant atmosphere perfect for a night out or a pre-game stop.
deals: Happy hour menu available daily 4pm-6pm and 10pm-close

Tue: ½ off tequilas $16 & up $6-$7 select food

venues.name: Otto Izakaya
venues.description: Otto Izakaya is a Japanese gastropub offering a fusion of traditional Japanese, Korean, and Chinese cuisine. It provides a welcoming space to linger with friends, featuring a variety of small plates and a dedicated sushi menu.

venues.name: Holliday Brewing Inman
venues.description: Situated on a four-acre property in downtown Inman, this brewery and full-service restaurant features a spacious taproom and a dedicated 21+ mezzanine level. Guests can enjoy house-made craft beers, seltzers, and cocktails alongside a menu of burgers, wraps, and wings.
deals: Wednesday ½ price bottles of wine
